links.outcome: Citation integrity (relevance, accuracy, existence, source quality) of LLM answers to guideline questions
links.effect: Baseline citation integrity was 96.8% (231/239) for GPT-5 Thinking and 64.6% (173/268) for Gemini 2.5 Pro; with Deep Research 100% and 98.6%.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro showed substantially lower baseline performance (64.6% [173/268]; 95% CI: 58.5%-70.3%) but improved to 98.6% (274/278; 95% CI: 96.4%-99.6%) with Deep Research.

links.outcome: Citation integrity with versus without live web search/Deep Research grounding
links.effect: GPT-5 Thinking improved from 96.8% (231/239) to 100% (176/176); Gemini 2.5 Pro improved from 64.6% (173/268) to 98.6% (274/278) with Deep Research.
links.quote: Built-in LWS functions are particularly helpful in ensuring citation reliability.

screen.practice: retrieval grounding via live web search/deep research
screen.reason: The study directly tests and compares LLM configurations with and without deep research / live web search grounding (Deep Research capability) to evaluate its impact on guideline concordance and citation integrity/hallucination mitigation.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
